verdict.rationale: Veriff documents native iOS and Android SDKs, a web InContext SDK, and React Native and Flutter wrappers. These deliver its built-in verification flow, which captures end-user media for you. Nothing in the evidence describes glare, blur, or edge-detection coaching during document capture. Missing for 10: documented glare/blur/edge detection and real-time capture coaching, evidence of first-try capture success rates, independent hands-on corroboration of capture quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: Bring the end-user to verification flow using web or native SDKs
you prefer leveraging **Veriff's front-end solution**, wish to maximize the benefits of our **built-in verification flow**, and have **no plans to independently collect end-user media**
Veriff iOS SDK requires at least iOS version 15.0
Veriff Android SDK needs your minSdkVersion to be of 26 or above
Veriff InContext solution allows your **end-users to go through the verification process within your web page**
